fields.name: Full name
fields.cnicHint: 13 digits, as on the identity card.
fields.legalEntityHint: Who employs this person. Records stay within this entity.
fields.startDateHint: The first working day. Up to 90 days ahead.

dashboard.title: HR overview
dashboard.intro: Staff, duty and attendance at {{site}}. Every figure opens the records behind it.
dashboard.noneNow: No shift is running at this moment.
dashboard.short: Below the minimum: bring in cover.

attention.leave_conflict: {{name}} asked for leave on {{date}} and is on the {{shift}} shift
attention.roster_draft: The roster from {{week}} is still a draft
attention.correction_one: {{count}} attendance correction waiting for a decision
attention.correction_other: {{count}} attendance corrections waiting for a decision
attention.leave_one: {{count}} leave request waiting for a decision
attention.leave_other: {{count}} leave requests waiting for a decision

employees.title: Employees
employees.intro: Everyone employed at the society, with their duty today. Personal and financial details stay inside each person's record.

newEmployee.title: New employee
newEmployee.intro: Record who they are, who employs them and where they work. Their first shift is assigned next, in Employee 360.
newEmployee.identityNote: Seen only by HR managers; never shown to residents or in the staff directory.
newEmployee.employmentNote: The legal entity and site decide which records this person belongs to.
newEmployee.duplicate: This CNIC already belongs to {{code}} {{name}}. One person has one record: open it to rehire or update.

e360.title: Employee 360
e360.profileName: Name and role ({{role}}) while on duty, with recorded consent.
e360.profileNone: Role only ({{role}}) while on duty. No consent to show the name.
e360.personalRestricted: Personal details are visible to HR managers only.
e360.noUpcoming: No duty in the next 7 days.
e360.noUpcomingHint: Assign a shift to put this person on the roster.
e360.noHistory: No duty in the last 14 days.
e360.attendanceNote: Recorded by supervisors; corrections go through a second person.
e360.editNote: Changes to this record are kept in its history.
e360.otherSitesNote: Read only for you: {{name}} also works at a site you do not manage. Their details, resident profile, documents, leave, advances and employment can be changed only by someone responsible for all of their sites. Duties and attendance at your own sites are not affected.

assign.title: Assign a shift
assign.subtitle: Nobody is booked twice, and approved leave is respected. You are told about pending leave first.
assign.personHint: Available people first; anyone who cannot take it says why.

blocked.not_at_site: Not working at this site then

assign.leaveBody: This person has asked for leave covering this date. The request is not decided yet. Assign anyway, or choose someone else?

roster.title: Duty roster
roster.intro: Weekly shifts for the site. A draft week is seen only here; publishing makes it the staff's and residents' roster.
roster.draftNote: Draft: staff and residents do not see this week yet.

warning.approved_leave: {{date}}, {{shift}}: {{name}} is on approved leave; reassign the duty

roster.gridLabel: Week roster (scroll sideways for more days)
roster.gridCaption: Duty roster for the week starting {{from}}

leaveExplain.pending: {{name}} has asked for leave on this date; the request is not decided yet.
leaveExplain.approved: {{name}} is on approved leave on this date: assign someone else to this duty.

roster.swapNone: No other duty in this department this week can be swapped.
roster.unassignEffect: The duty is cancelled and kept in the history. Coverage is checked again.
roster.startedNote: This duty has begun: it can no longer be swapped or removed.
roster.publishEffect_one: Staff and residents will see this week's roster. {{count}} shift is still below the minimum.
roster.publishEffect_other: Staff and residents will see this week's roster. {{count}} shifts are still below the minimum.
roster.templatesNote: The society's shift times, posts and minimum staff. A shift below its minimum shows a warning; it is never refused.

board.notPublished: This week's roster is not published: staff and residents do not see these duties yet.
board.nobody: No shift is running at this moment.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.intro: Check-in, check-out and absence by shift. Late counts from {{minutes}} minutes after the start (a society setting). A night shift belongs to the day it starts.
attendance.readOnly: You can see attendance but not record it.
attendance.absentEffect: The shift's coverage is checked again and a replacement can be brought in. A mistake is fixed with a correction approved by someone else.

correction.title: Correct {{name}}'s attendance
correction.subtitle: A request: the record changes only when someone else with the approval permission agrees.
correction.stateFromTimes: On time or late follows from the check-in time. On a night shift, a time before it starts is the next morning.
correction.reasonHint: At least 10 characters: what shows the right times (gate log, handover …).
correction.approvalNote: You cannot approve your own request, and nobody approves a correction of their own attendance.
correction.rule: Recording attendance and approving a change are separate permissions. The requester and the person concerned never decide.
correction.approveEffect: The attendance record changes to the new values; the old ones stay in its history.
correction.rejectEffect: The attendance record stays as it is.

blocked.own_request: You asked for this, so someone else decides it.
blocked.own_record: This is about you, so someone else decides it.
blocked.other_sites: This person also works at a site you do not manage, so someone responsible for all of their sites decides it.

leave.title: Leave and corrections
leave.intro: Leave requests and attendance corrections, each decided by someone other than the person and the requester.
leave.newSubtitle: Duties on the roster in these dates are listed for the decision.
leave.conflictsToast_one: It covers {{count}} duty on the roster.
leave.conflictsToast_other: It covers {{count}} duties on the roster.
leave.policyNote: Leave entitlements depend on a leave policy the society has not adopted yet, so no balance is calculated. Days taken are recorded.
leave.balanceNote: No balance is calculated until the society adopts a leave policy. Taken this year: {{taken}}.
leave.conflicts_one: {{count}} duty on the roster in these dates:
leave.conflicts_other: {{count}} duties on the roster in these dates:
leave.conflictsApproved_one: Approved leave: {{count}} duty needs someone else:
leave.conflictsApproved_other: Approved leave: {{count}} duties need someone else:
leave.approveEffect: The leave is recorded as approved.
leave.approveEffectConflicts_one: The leave is approved and {{count}} duty becomes a gap on the roster to fill.
leave.approveEffectConflicts_other: The leave is approved and {{count}} duties become gaps on the roster to fill.
leave.rejectEffect: The request is closed with your reason.

documents.title: Employee documents
documents.intro: Required documents for every current employee, with what is missing or expiring. Fictional files: only a file's name, type and size are kept.
documents.simulated: A simulated upload: the file stays on your device; only its name, type and size are recorded.
documents.fileHint: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB.
documents.privacy: Identity and police documents are seen only by people who manage HR documents. Numbers are always masked on screen.
documents.restrictedNote: You see each document's status only. Files, numbers and history are for people who manage HR documents.

status.title: Change {{name}}'s status
status.subtitle: Effective-dated. Future duties after the change are cancelled and kept in the history.

effect.suspended: No duties from today; this person cannot be assigned until reinstated.
effect.ended: Duties after the last working day are cancelled; the record and its history are kept.
effect.reinstate: This person can be assigned again.
effect.rehire: A new employment period starts on the chosen date; earlier periods stay on record.

profile.title: What residents see of {{name}}
profile.subtitle: Residents see who is on duty from the published roster.
profile.always: While on duty, residents always see the role: {{role}}.
profile.consent: {{name}} agrees that residents may see the following
profile.showInitials: Show initials instead of a photo
profile.never: Phone number, CNIC or identity details, pay, advances or loans, attendance history, home address and personal documents.
profile.saved: Saved. Residents see this from now on.

advances.title: Advances and loans
advances.intro: Staff advances and loans, decided by someone other than the requester and the staff member.
advances.newSubtitle: A request needs a reason, a repayment plan and supporting evidence.
advances.ruleTitle: An approval is not a payment
advances.neverPaid: Approving a request is an instruction, not a payment. PropertyOS cannot yet verify that a staff advance was paid or repaid, so nothing here is shown as paid, received or owed.

kindHint.loan: Repaid in up to 36 monthly instalments.

advances.approvedExplain: Approved as an instruction. A payment of this advance cannot be verified yet: nothing is recorded as paid, and nothing is owed.
advances.planNote: A plan, not a deduction: no instalment is recorded as received (repayment evidence needs S.2b).
advances.noPolicy: The society has no adopted limits for advances or loans yet; the approver decides each request.

effect.approve: This is an instruction only. Nothing is recorded as paid to {{name}}.
effect.reject: The request for {{name}} is closed with your reason.
effect.withdraw: The request for {{name}} is withdrawn; nothing is paid.

advances.approvedUnverifiedNote: Approved instructions. Whether any of this was paid cannot be verified yet, so nothing is counted as owed.

settlement.title: Advance and loan settlement
settlement.intro: Why the payment of an approved advance or loan is not verified yet, and what verification will need. Nothing here moves money.
settlement.partial: Paying staff by bank and deducting instalments from pay need payroll and outgoing bank payments, which are not built (S.2b). A cashbook voucher of the same amount does not prove that this employee received this advance, so vouchers cannot be linked here and no advance is shown as paid or repaid.

needs.subject: A cashbook voucher made for this advance or loan, naming it and the employee
needs.category: An approved category for staff advances, not ordinary expense or income
needs.entity: The employing legal entity and the site
needs.direction: A payment out for the advance; receipts in for repayments
needs.amount: The exact amount and the posting date
needs.posted: Posted, not reversed, and used once; a later reversal undoes it
needs.approval: Approved by someone other than whoever prepared it

history.consent_given: Consent recorded for residents to see the profile
history.document_replaced: Document replaced by a new version

errors.nameShort: Enter the full name (at least 3 letters).
errors.name: Use letters, spaces, dots, apostrophes and hyphens only.
errors.phone: Enter a Pakistani mobile number, e.g. 0300 1234567.
errors.site: Choose a site of this organisation.
errors.startDate: Choose a start date from 2000 up to 90 days ahead.
errors.dob: The person must be at least 18 on the start date.
errors.endDate: The last day cannot be before the start date.
errors.rehireDate: Rehire from a date after the last employment ended.
errors.post: Choose one of this shift's posts.
errors.coverNotFound: The duty to cover was not found on this shift.
errors.swapWith: Choose a duty to swap with.
errors.week: Choose the Monday that starts the week.
errors.checkInTime: Enter a check-in time within the shift (or up to 2 hours before).
errors.checkOutTime: The check-out must be after the check-in and within 6 hours of the shift's end.
errors.noChange: That is what is recorded already.
errors.leaveDates: The last day must be on or after the first, and within 60 days.
errors.leaveBackdated: Leave can be recorded up to 30 days back.
errors.afterEnd: The leave runs past the employment's last day.
errors.fileType: Use a PDF, JPG or PNG file.
errors.fileSize: The file must be at most 5 MB.
errors.issuedFuture: The issue date cannot be in the future.
errors.expiryRequired: This document needs an expiry date.
errors.expiryOrder: The expiry must be after the issue date.
errors.cnicMismatch: The CNIC number must be this employee's own.
errors.advanceKind: Choose an advance or a loan.
errors.amount: Enter an amount above zero, with at most two decimals.
errors.instalmentTooSmall: Each instalment must be at least PKR 1.
errors.firstMonth: Choose a month from this month up to a year ahead.
errors.voucherUnknown: That voucher is not a posted voucher of this society.
errors.duplicateElsewhere: This identity number is already on an employee record at another of the organisation's sites. Ask the HR office that manages that site.

problems.duplicate: This person is already on record.
problems.stateChanged: This has changed since you opened it. Refresh and try again.
problems.employmentEnded: This employment has ended: rehire to make changes.
problems.reassignFirst: Reassign this person's coming duties before moving them to another department.
problems.coverNotNeeded: Cover is only for someone marked absent or on leave.
problems.alreadyCovered: Someone is already covering this duty.
problems.dutyStarted: This duty has begun or has attendance recorded: it can no longer be changed.
problems.overlap: This would book the person twice.
problems.overlapDetail: {{name}} is already on duty at that time (at any site).
problems.onLeave: The person is on approved leave.
problems.onLeaveDetail: {{name}} is on approved leave on that date.
problems.notAtSite: The person does not work at this site on that date.
problems.notAtSiteDetail: {{name}} is not allocated to this site on that date.
problems.notEmployed: The person is not employed on that date.
problems.notEmployedDetail: {{name}} is not employed, or is suspended, on that date.
problems.otherDepartment: That shift belongs to another department.
problems.leavePending: There is a pending leave request on that date.
problems.leavePendingDetail: {{name}} has asked for leave on that date.
problems.nothingToPublish: Nothing has changed since the week was published.
problems.notYourDepartment: You record attendance for your own department only.
problems.alreadyRecorded: Attendance is already recorded for this duty.
problems.notOnDutyTime: Check-in opens an hour before the shift and closes when it ends.
problems.notCheckedIn: There is no check-in to close.
problems.tooEarlyAbsentDetail: Wait until {{minutes}} minutes after the shift starts.
problems.nothingToCorrect: Nothing is recorded yet: record the attendance first.
problems.correctionPending: A correction for this duty is already waiting for a decision.
problems.ownRequest: You asked for this, so someone else must decide it.
problems.ownRecord: This is about you, so someone else must decide it.
problems.leaveOverlap: Leave already covers some of these days.
problems.otherSites: This employee also works at a site you do not manage. Their record (details, role, resident profile, documents, leave, advances and employment) can be changed only by someone responsible for all of their sites. Nothing was changed.
problems.settlementUnverifiable: Payments of staff advances cannot be verified yet. Nothing was linked and nothing changed.
